title: Peri-procedural Weighted Blanket Use for ECT
official: Effect of Peri-procedural Weighted Blanket Use on Pre-ECT Anxiety and Post-ECT Agitation: A Pilot Crossover Design RCT Study.
summary:
The goal of this clinical trial is to learn if weighted blanket use before and after electroconvulsant therapy (ECT) works to reduce pre-ECT anxiety and post-ECT agitation.

The main questions it aims to answer are:

Does weighted blanket use before and after ECT reduce patient reported anxiety before ECT? Does weighted blanket use before and after ECT reduce post-ECT agitation following ECT?

Participants will:

Use either a weighted blanket or a non-weighted blanket before and after ECT. Report their anxiety before ECT Be observed for post-ECT agitation as they awaken from anesthesia after ECT.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Hospitalized
* Undergoing induction series of ECT

Exclusion Criteria:

* Unable to complete visual analog anxiety assessment scale
* Court-ordered ECT
